purpose: paired control isolating ideal array geometry from the stored HFSS active-element operator

models.common_element_envelope: At each target direction, use RMS HFSS per-port field norm as one common element envelope, then apply only the ideal geometric phase. Removes port-dependent embedded-pattern/coupling structure while retaining direction-dependent element strength.
models.isotropic_boresight_calibrated: Use a direction-independent element field norm equal to the nearest-boresight RMS HFSS per-port field norm, then apply ideal geometric phase. Removes element scan loss as well as coupling/asymmetry.

causal_boundary: A difference between HFSS and common-element-envelope models measures all port-dependent full-wave nonidealities together; it cannot identify mutual coupling alone without a no-coupling full-wave model or network de-embedding.
